newsitem.title: UK: Birkby Plc to buy British Coal Enterprise.
newsitem.headline: Birkby Plc to buy British Coal Enterprise.

text.p: British workspace management firm Birkby Plc said on Wednesday that it had agreed to buy British Coal Enterprise Ltd from British Coal Corporation for around 20 million stg.
British Coal Enterprise (BCE)'s main asset is a portfolio of 50 workspace centres which on October 31, 1996 produced an annual equivalent gross rent of 3.97 million stg.
The centres have been valued at 24 million stg, the company said in statement.
The acquisition would be subject to shareholder approval on January 7, 1997.
The market appeared to welcome the acquisition as its share price gained 11 1/2 pence at 192 at 1230 GMT.
Anthony Lewis, Birkby's chairman said: "The portfolio comprises good quality workspace with a geographical spread that is complementary to our own."
